name: comfypilot
description: MCP server for live control of ComfyUI v0.20-v0.31.1+ with 96 tools across 20 categories, including strict validation, resilient jobs/events, Desktop control, generic artifacts, workers, lifecycle, and diagnostics.
author: ComfyPilot

COMFY_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for ComfyUI authentication (Authorization: Bearer for local, X-API-Key for Comfy Cloud)

COMFY_AUTH_METHOD.description: Auth header style: auto | bearer | x-api-key

COMFY_SNAPSHOT_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of workflow snapshots to retain

COMFY_SNAPSHOT_DIR.description: Optional directory to persist snapshots across restarts. If unset, snapshots are in-memory only.

COMFY_BLUEPRINT_DIR.description: Directory for user-published subgraph blueprints. Falls back to bundled examples.

COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Default output directory for saved images

COMFY_STRICT_CONFIRM.description: Set to '1' to fail-closed on destructive tools (clear_queue, clear_history, delete_history, delete_snapshot, emergency_stop) when the host lacks elicitation support. Default is fail-open for backward compatibility.
